note: P35.51 (SIG-UI-041, SIG-FIND-005, ADR-155) — the per-page-type budgets, K0-interactive-architecture §4.3's table verbatim (KiB = 1,024 B). Single budget truth: supersedes island-budgets.json in the same change (recorded seam — the old per-island ceilings retire, the T2 surfaces keep their measured envelopes inside the per-type rows). budget.spec.ts wire-measures every discovered route against these rows — gzip AND brotli, before and after one scripted interaction per surface — and gen-lhci.mjs renders the Lighthouse assertMatrix from the same file. The budgets are the law: raising one, or adding a T2 surface, is a new ADR amending ADR-155, never an edit here.

T1.description: one scripted user action (a scroll + a click on an in-page control where one exists). Today no T1 enhancement element ships (t1-module-entries.json is empty), so the post-action measure asserts the ceiling — the row still bounds what any UXK0-4 element may load.

map.description: one scripted pan of the map canvas — measures the per-pan/zoom data budget and any post-action scripts. Effect asserted: the map's rendered state moved (centre or tile requests).

graph.description: select a non-focused node — the expansion one ring at a time. Effect asserted: aria-pressed flips to true on the selected node (the same effect islands.spec.ts asserts).

search.description: type into the quick filter — measures the keystroke-shard data budget. Effect asserted: the rendered result set narrows.

measured_gaps.note: the ratified ≤ 360 KiB is LAW — it is not relaxed. The P36.37 head's /map/ wire measure is 482,469 B gzip / 402,308 B brotli (the ESM-split MapLibre vendor chunks are fetched over the wire at runtime; the export leg's dist measure resolves the same runtime module graphs per fetching realm — /map/vendor/ entries discovered from the serialized vendorBase + the chunk's basename literals — and reports 488,362 B gzip). Re-recorded once at the wire measure under the same deferral, ceilings untouched. The gap is recorded, bounded and loud: budget.spec.ts fails if the measure grows past regression_bound (512 KiB), reports the ratified ceiling every run, and fails if this row stays after the bundle drops under the ratified ceiling. The generated lighthouserc asserts the ratified ceiling as a warn and the regression bound as the error gate for this metric only — the row's fix is the owner's, never a smoothed budget.
